name: What questions should you ask before starting a commercial renovation?

mainEntity.name: What are the most important questions to ask before starting a commercial renovation?
mainEntity.text: What are the most important questions to ask before starting a commercial renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting a commercial renovation, owners should ask questions that reveal how the project will actually be managed. Key topics include the exact scope of work, permit responsibility, expected timeline, budget allowances, change-order procedures, and how hidden conditions will be handled. It is also important to ask who will supervise the site, how communication will work, whether the business can stay open during construction, and what safety measures will protect staff and customers. Owners should clarify what is excluded from the proposal so they are not surprised later by items like fixtures, permit fees, or utility upgrades. If the project involves a leased space, landlord approval requirements should be confirmed early. The best contractors give direct answers, explain risks plainly, and provide a process rather than just a price. These questions help owners compare bids more accurately and choose a team that can complete the project without unnecessary delays or budget overruns.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about scope, permits, timeline, budget, change orders, lead times, occupied-site safety, and who will manage the project day to day. You should also confirm what is excluded, how inspections are handled, and what happens if hidden conditions appear after demolition.
